American Touch Tag Day

images.alt:
American Touch Tag Day is observed annually on October 8th in the United States.
This unotticial holiday celebrates the simple childhood game of tag, also known as "touch tag." The purpose of the day is to encourage people-kids and adults alike-to get outside, be physically active, and enjoy the classic playground game.
Touch tag is the version of the game where one person is "it" and must chase and lightly touch (or "tag" someone else, who then becomes "it." It's one of the oldest and simplest forms of playground games, requiring no equipment and offering fun, exercise, and social interaction.

Purpose of the Day:
• It encourages people to get up and move.
• Tag games help build friendships and teamwork
• Reminds adults and children alike of the joy of simple games.
How to Celebrate:
• Organize a game of tag at school, in parks, or in the backyard.
• Use the day as an opportunity to teach kids about classic playground games.
• Reminisce about your favorite tag variations (freeze tag, TV tag, etc.).
• Share photos or stories on social media using #AmericanTouchTagDay.

【長期の「医食同源」プログラムが成人の心代謝健康の改善と関連】

EBIS世界の最新健康・栄養ニュース
2026年10月9日 06:54

植物性食品を中心とする食料パッケージを長期間、定期的に提供する「医食同源（Food is Medicine）」プログラムへの参加が、成人の血圧、体重、BMIの改善と関連し、提供回数が多いほど改善幅も大きかった、という研究報告。

研究チームは、ブリガム・リビア地域保健センターのフードパントリーを利用した成人68人について、プログラム参加前後の健康データを解析した。
